hero.subtitle: Where the Sea Meets the Table

about.body: Born on the shores of Napoli, VELA brings the untamed spirit of coastal Italian cuisine to every plate. We cook with the finest catches from the Tyrrhenian Sea, handmade pasta, and a relentless obsession with simplicity done perfectly.

items.name: Spaghetti alle Vongole
items.description: Fresh clams, white wine, garlic, chilli, flat-leaf parsley, hand-pulled spaghetti.
items.alt: Spaghetti alle vongole in a wide bowl

items.name: Branzino al Sale
items.description: Whole sea bass baked in a salt crust, lemon butter, capers, Amalfi olive oil.
items.alt: Sea bass emerging from salt crust

items.name: Risotto al Nero di Seppia
items.description: Carnaroli rice, cuttlefish ink, grilled calamari, mascarpone, Prosecco.
items.alt: Black squid ink risotto with calamari
